name: Red Studio
vibe: Bold, friendly and colourful: a red-and-black studio look with your illustrated portrait on a flip-over ID badge, a talking hero video and playful scroll animations.
features: Full-screen hero with your talking video (play reel)
Dropping ID badge that flips to a visiting card with QR code
Scroll-drawn "My Process" path and skills grid
Projects, experience timeline and soft-skills cards
Fluid WebGL splash-cursor and animated preloader

name: Cinematic Lime
vibe: Dark, minimal and editorial: a giant metallic headline that scrambles in, your full-body portrait rising in front of it, an electric-lime services accordion and large case-study project stories.
features: Letter-scramble hero: your name becomes PORTFOLIO, then your portrait rises
Word-by-word scroll-reveal intro with glass card
Four-row skills ticker moving in alternating directions
Full-width lime accordion for your services
Alternating editorial project stories with hover zoom
Premium contact form and a full-screen cinematic footer

name: Signal HUD
vibe: Dark, technical and motion-led: a heads-up-display portfolio with a live 3D wireframe core, a name that decodes from random characters, buttery smooth scrolling and a pinned sideways project gallery.
features: Live 3D wireframe centrepiece you can drag to rotate
Text-decode effect on your name and section labels
HUD top bar with a live local clock and rotating status
Pinned horizontal project gallery with progress line
Scroll-filled journey timeline, terminal-style contact form and crosshair cursor
